jobs.title: KOL & Influencer Marketing Intern
jobs.description: As a KOL & Influencer Marketing Intern, youll support the team in planning and executing influencer campaigns that grow KitaLulus brand awareness and user acquisition. Youll be involved in researching and reaching out to KOLs, coordinating campaign deliverables, tracking performance, and preparing campaign reports. Track campaign performance metrics such as views, reach, engagement, clicks, downloads, and conversions. Assist in preparing weekly/monthly campaign reports and performance recaps. Support KOL budget, invoice, and other campaign administrative tracking. Job Requirements: Final-year student or fresh graduate in Marketing, Communication, PR, Business, or related fields. Passionate about social media, influencer, and digital marketing. Basic understanding of influencer marketing and social media metrics. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Proficient in Google Sheets/Microsoft Excel. Experience in influencer marketing, social media, organizations, or marketing projects is a plus.
